title: Mosco variational resolvent bridge for the anchored comparison
question: Do exact common-space liminf and recovery hypotheses identify every anchored resolvent limit with the R-512 minimal-form resolvent, before any semigroup or physical interpretation?
purpose: Make the N2b form route mathematically explicit. The result is a conditional variational selection argument; it does not import an unmatched Mosco theorem or assert that the required source hypotheses hold.

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho, original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates, labelled Gibbs state, OMC-010 regulator path and OMC-004 relational strip.
fixed_scope.forms: E_n are the unchanged anchored finite reversible forms after the registered j limit; E_min is exactly the R-512 minimal closed nonnegative form.
fixed_scope.comparison: U_n and the common Hilbert space H are source-authorized antecedents only. No conditional averaging, direct sum or replacement carrier is introduced.
fixed_scope.parameter: For each fixed lambda>0, use the variational resolvent objectives J_n(u)=E_n(u)+lambda||u-U_n f_n||^2 and J(u)=E_min(u)+lambda||u-f||^2.
fixed_scope.order: The original j-to-infinity passage at fixed n precedes anchored n; no diagonal, reversed or joint limit.
fixed_scope.time: This checkpoint is static in the resolvent parameter lambda and does not reinterpret external stochastic Markov time.

objects.resolvent_minimizers: u_n is a minimizer of J_n and u is the unique minimizer of J; the source packet must define them on one common H through U_n.
objects.liminf: For every anchored sequence U_n w_n converging weakly to w, E_min(w,w)<=liminf_n E_n(w_n,w_n), with the full arbitrary-sequence quantifier.
objects.recovery: For every local target v in Dom(E_min), a source-authorized v_n converges strongly through U_n and limsup_n E_n(v_n,v_n)<=E_min(v,v).
objects.selection: The lambda||u-f||^2 term is strictly convex for lambda>0, so the exact target minimizer is unique once E_min is fixed.

required_owner_packet.common_space_equicoercivity: One H and U_n with source-resolvent minimizers bounded in a topology giving weakly convergent subsequences or nets, plus local norm compatibility.
required_owner_packet.arbitrary_sequence_liminf: The N2b liminf inequality for every bounded-energy anchored sequence, not only the registered recovery sequence.
required_owner_packet.recovery_sequence: A recovery sequence for every local target test vector, with the anchored quantifier and the unchanged terminal-square convention.
required_owner_packet.data_recovery: U_n f_n converges strongly to f for each local cylinder and preserves the original stationary normalization in J_n.
required_owner_packet.target_exact_unique: The limiting objective is exactly the R-512 minimal form and lambda>0 supplies uniqueness; no maximal extension is substituted.
required_owner_packet.norm_upgrade: A source-authorized energy/norm argument upgrades weak resolvent convergence to strong convergence on every local cylinder.
required_owner_packet.semigroup_bridge: A separate source-authorized resolvent-to-compact-time-correlation bridge is still required; this contract does not silently identify resolvents with semigroups.

conditional_theorem.energy_sandwich: For any weak cluster u of u_n, liminf_n J_n(u_n)>=J(u), while a recovery sequence gives limsup_n inf J_n<=J(u).
conditional_theorem.cluster_selection: The two inequalities force every cluster point to minimize J; strict convexity from lambda>0 makes it the unique R_min^lambda f.
conditional_theorem.strong_resolvent: If the norm-upgrade field is supplied, U_n u_n converges strongly to R_min^lambda f for every local f and lambda>0.
conditional_theorem.scope_boundary: Strong resolvent convergence alone is not called compact-time semigroup convergence here; the semigroup_bridge field remains open.

diagnostic_fixture.description: A scalar quadratic oracle computes the exact resolvent minimizer lambda*f/(k+lambda) for a decreasing coefficient sequence. It tests the variational algebra only and is not a PAH estimate.
diagnostic_fixture.role: Exact test oracle for minimizer uniqueness and convergence; no PAH carrier, source rate, physical constant or infinite-volume assertion.

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only when all variational owner fields and the separate semigroup bridge are source-authorized, hash-pinned and independently verified.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact PAH-specific violation of the arbitrary-sequence liminf, recovery, or target uniqueness requirements qualifies; the scalar oracle is not a PAH counterexample.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use while any common-space, liminf, recovery, norm-upgrade or semigroup field is absent.

single_next_question: Can a source-authorized N2b packet supply the common U_n/Hilbert space, arbitrary-sequence liminf, all-local recovery and norm upgrade needed to identify the R-512 resolvent, without changing PAH-001?
revisit_condition: Reopen only when the missing owner fields are versioned and hash-pinned or an exact PAH-specific liminf/recovery contradiction is found; do not repeat finite carrier or physical-empty calculations.
non_claims: No source-authorized common U_n, N2b liminf/recovery, norm upgrade, R-512 resolvent identification or semigroup convergence.
No import of a generic Mosco theorem with unmatched hypotheses and no change to PAH-001 function, rates, state, carrier, regulator, normalization or order.
The scalar quadratic oracle is not a PAH counterexample and does not prove a universal impossibility theorem.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang-Mills or TOE conclusion.
